digest.component_or_area: LLM runner and GitHub Actions workflows
propositions: Token usage data (input/output/cache tokens and request count) generated by PydanticAIRunner.run is captured in result[_usage] but never reaches the two weekly LLM jobs (external-integration and prompt-eval), leaving no retrievable record of billable calls.

The external pytest job and eval-live job both route through the same PydanticAIRunner.run seam but drop or suppress usage metadata before reporting, and the ephemeral Langfuse backend used by langfuse-trace job is torn down after each run.

A new opt-in usage sink via REBAR_USAGE_LOG environment variable should record token usage to a JSONL file and provide a CLI summarize command to generate Markdown reports for job summaries and artifacts.
The implementation must be zero-impact when REBAR_USAGE_LOG is unset and must not raise exceptions into the LLM call path, keeping src/rebar/llm/runner.py within the 800-LOC limit.
Both weekly workflows must be updated to set REBAR_USAGE_LOG, append summarize output to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY with if:always(), and upload the raw JSONL artifact for durable machine-readable record.
